mappings.body:
- id: applet-yubihsm
    status: manual
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: package
    v1: v1 YubiHSM or HSM Auth APIs
    v2: Yubico.YubiKit.YubiHsm
    evidence:
      - develop:Yubico.YubiKey/src/Yubico/YubiKey/YubiHsmAuth/YubiHsmAuthSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiHsm/
    notes: The package manages the YubiKey YubiHSM Auth applet and calculates session keys. The application uses an HSM library for connector sessions, HSM object enrollment and protected commands. Manually preserve the YubiKey label/HSM authentication-key ID mapping and provision matching long-lived keys on both devices; see the module README enrollment guide.
    last_reviewed_commit: e348013685d92a6a665cd0b8bd7e8b05850fddd5

- id: yubihsm-retry-exception
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: behavior
    v1: YubiHsmAuthSession.TryAddCredential / TryDeleteCredential / TryChangeManagementKey / TryGetAes128SessionKeys / TryGetEccP256SessionKeys with out int? retriesRemaining
    v2: HsmAuthRetryException.RetriesRemaining thrown from the corresponding single-attempt *Async methods
    evidence:
      - yubikit:src/YubiHsm/src/HsmAuthRetryException.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: The initial v2 snapshot embedded retry counts in exception messages (historical gap 13). Current enrollment, deletion, management-key changes, both CALCULATE methods and both password-change methods translate retry-count statuses into HsmAuthRetryException.RetriesRemaining. The type derives from ApduException. GetChallengeAsync uses general ApduException errors, including with a password; inspect its status word when applying retry policy. Each SDK call makes one attempt; the application decides whether to prompt and retry.
    last_reviewed_commit: e042280ed7ec03a0250745ff3ff272680e5570b9

- id: yubihsm-touch-notify
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: behavior
    v1: YubiHsmAuthSession touch-required notification during CalculateSessionKeys* (interactive KeyCollector-adjacent callback)
    v2: SessionCreationOptions.UserPresencePrompt (IUserPresencePrompt) supplied when creating HsmAuthSession
    evidence:
      - yubikit:src/Core/src/Credentials/IUserPresencePrompt.cs
      - yubikit:src/Core/src/Sessions/SessionCreationOptions.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiHsm/src/HsmAuthSession.cs
      - yubikit:docs/usage/user-interaction.md
    notes: The initial v2 snapshot had no "please touch" signal (historical gap 13), and an intermediate alpha added HsmAuthSession.OnTouchRequired. That alpha property was removed outright in favor of the cross-applet IUserPresencePrompt supplied through SessionCreationOptions. A known touch-required credential produces PolicyRequires; an unknown touch value on a found credential or LIST failure produces PolicyMayRequire and should be debounced; a credential label absent from a successful LIST remains silent. Context includes the credential label as Scope, so terminal implementations may omit Scope to avoid exposing metadata. Implementations must return promptly and must not call back into the session. See user-presence-prompt for the shared contract.
    last_reviewed_commit: 2918ae0774e182a58cbc98c03c27defc5d18bc43

- id: yubihsm-credential-retries-remaining-rename
    status: automatic
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: member
    v1: HsmAuthAuthenticationInfo/credential list trailing byte documented as "retries remaining before deletion"
    v2: HsmAuthCredential.RetriesRemaining (renamed from an earlier v2-only Counter member)
    evidence:
      - yubikit:src/YubiHsm/src/HsmAuthCredential.cs
      - yubikit:docs/plans/yubikit-gaps-remediation/ISA.md
    notes: An earlier v2-only Counter member described this byte as a usage counter (historical gap 13). The rename to RetriesRemaining followed a recorded 8-to-7 failed-authentication observation. Current LIST results are snapshots. Yubico's descriptive YubiHSM Auth overview says successful authentication before exhaustion restores retries to eight; exhaustion deletes the credential. Management-key exhaustion instead blocks management operations until destructive applet reset. Refresh LIST or the management retry query to observe current state; historical observation scope remains in the remediation records.
    last_reviewed_commit: e042280ed7ec03a0250745ff3ff272680e5570b9

- id: yubihsm-credential-password-bytes
    status: assisted
    confidence: high
    migration_kind: member
    v1: YubiHsmAuthSession credential-password parameters (ReadOnlyMemory<byte> in Symmetric.cs; string in Aes128CredentialWithSecrets.cs and related asymmetric/admin members)
    v2: IHsmAuthSession/HsmAuthSession password parameters as UTF-8 ReadOnlyMemory<byte> (credentialPassword, derivationPassword, currentPassword, newPassword)
    evidence:
      - yubikit:src/YubiHsm/src/HsmAuthSession.cs
      - yubikit:src/YubiHsm/src/IHsmAuthSession.cs
      - yubikit:docs/migration/v1-to-v2-changelog.md
    notes: The initial v2 snapshot regressed nine IHsmAuthSession/HsmAuthSession members (11 parameters) to a string credential-password parameter, which .NET cannot securely zero. This finished the sweep started for Fido2/OpenPgp/Oath (`75353fd1`, 2026-04-09) and closes a v1 regression rather than introducing one - v1's YubiHsmAuthSession.Symmetric.cs path already took a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> credentialPassword. Affected members - PutCredentialSymmetricAsync, PutCredentialDerivedAsync, CalculateSessionKeysSymmetricAsync, CalculateSessionKeysAsymmetricAsync, GetChallengeAsync, PutCredentialAsymmetricAsync, GenerateCredentialAsymmetricAsync, ChangeCredentialPasswordAsync, ChangeCredentialPasswordAdminAsync. Breaking, with no [Obsolete] overload (package is 2.0.0-alpha.2). Migrate by passing Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password) and zeroing the resulting array in a finally, or an owning buffer type that zeroes on disposal; validation (max 16 UTF-8 bytes, null-padded) and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 derivation are unchanged. The same change corrected the GetChallengeAsync firmware boundary (5.6.0 supports the command without a password; 5.7.1 adds the optional password field) and added session-key context-length validation (8-byte host+HSM challenges for symmetric; 65-byte EPK-OCE+EPK-SD for asymmetric) before device I/O; see the 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-03 changelog entries for full detail. The parameters briefly carried a `...Utf8` suffix (`credentialPasswordUtf8`, etc.); `refactor(yubihsm,core): drop Utf8 param suffix and split prompt types` (c5dc3aec) dropped that suffix in favor of the plain names shown above, matching the same rename applied to Fido2/OpenPgp/Oath (see `2026-09-05` changelog entry). Breaking for named arguments only.
    last_reviewed_commit: 277920d9de48d4aedad7ecc5d00201a015b5a297
